name: tracker-supervisor-rehearsal
goal: Run one native Tracker HTTPS-free loopback owner on a disposable database, and prove the packaged shim, startup exclusivity and same-database rollback.

evidence: Use an explicit isolated SQLite file under the OS temporary directory and an ephemeral loopback port. Live roles, secrets, adapters, schedulers and notifications stay outside this rehearsal. Verify legacy → native → legacy against one test-owned database and compare a quiesced snapshot.
